Devilish - Ball Bounder.name: Devilish: Ball Bounder
Devilish - Ball Bounder.summary: A breakout clone video game developed by Starfish for the Nintendo DS. It is the third entry in the Devilish series, released 13 years after Devilish: The Next Possession for the Genesis and like its predecessor, it is a game in the same genre of Breakout and Arkanoid, with elaborate fantasy visuals.

Ivy the Kiwi.name: Ivy the Kiwi?
Ivy the Kiwi.summary: Players of all ages are encouraged to aide Ivy on her journey, utilizing the Wii Remote or Nintendo DS stylus to create the stretchy and flexible vines that propel Ivy forward, over and through obstacles before her. Players encounter crows, rats, raindrops and more, all of which aim to hinder Ivy's progress. But every story's hero finds a way, and Ivy soon finds an ally in the unlikeliest of places-the strange vines that erupt forth to guide, protect and propel her on her way. As skill improves, players must more carefully and quickly manipulate the trusty vines in new ways and utilize the game's distinct mode of transport.

Johnny Bravo in the Hukka-Mega-Mighty-Ul.name: Johnny Bravo in The Hukka-Mega-Mighty-Ultra-Extreme Date-O-Rama!
Johnny Bravo in the Hukka-Mega-Mighty-Ul.summary: Step into the world of Johnny Bravo, the most well-known stud in cyberspace! Compete against other rivals in various events to win a coveted date with a sultry siren on the ultimate dating show, the Hukka-Mega-Mighty-Ultra-Extreme Date-O-Rama! Will you emerge victorious and capture the heart of the lovely lady?

Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger - Atsumete Hensh.name: Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger: Atsumete Henshin! 35 Sentai
Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger - Atsumete Hensh.summary: Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger: Gathered Transformation! 35 Sentai! is a Nintendo DS action game where the Gokaigers search for lost Ranger Keys after a Zangyack attack. Featuring minigames and the ability to transform into all Super Sentai teams, it combines battles and exploration in pursuit of the ultimate treasure.

Little Red Riding Hood's Zombie BBQ.name: Little Red Riding Hood's Zombie BBQ
Little Red Riding Hood's Zombie BBQ.summary: In Little Red Riding Hood's Zombie BBQ, Little "Ready to Rock" Riding Hood and her friend Momotaro face the greatest threat that has ever besieged folk tales.

Nanostray 2.name: Nanostray 2
Nanostray 2.summary: Nanostray 2 is a sequel to the DS shoot-em-up Nanostray released in 2005. It features improvements over it's prequel such as a new weapon system, enhanced touch controls, and unlockable minigames. It is developed by Shin'en Multimedia and published by Majesco.

Passeport du CE2 au CM1.name: Passeport du CE2 au CM1
Passeport du CE2 au CM1.summary: Passeport du CE2 au CM1 is an educational game for the Nintendo DS, offering 130 exercises divided into 26 sequences to help 8-9 year olds revise and prepare for the transition from CE2 to CM1.

Sangokushi Taisen DS.name: Sangokushi Taisen DS
Sangokushi Taisen DS.summary: A real-time strategy / card battle game based on the arcade title. This game is based on the Sangokushi (Romance of the Three Kingdoms) historical period.

Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters - World Champion.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008
Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters - World Champion.summary:
Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008 is one of the World Championship game series, that released for 2008.

Tournament dueling is back with the official software of Yu-Gi-Oh! World Tournament 2008! Battle it out on two exciting game modes: "World Championship" mode, and the new "Duel World" mode, where you can venture through events, meet duel spirits, and buy new cards.

Zettai Zetsumei Dangerous Jiisan DS - Da.name: Zettai Zetsumei Dangerous Jiisan DS: Dangerous Sensation
Zettai Zetsumei Dangerous Jiisan DS - Da.summary: A minigame collection based on the CoroCoro Comic serial, Zettai Zetsumei Dangerous Jiisan ("Grandpa Danger" in Viz Media's English version).
